planets.name: TOI-674 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-674 with a 1.98-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-674 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-674. Its orbit and size follow Murgas et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
